title: Hello, Adventurer
hints: Every line you print goes through `std::cout <<`. You can chain as many `<<` as you like on one statement.

`
` inside a string literal means 'newline'. So `std::cout << "hi
";` prints hi and then moves to the next line.
You need four printed lines. That can be four separate `std::cout` statements, or one big chain - both are correct.
